design.common_start: Deep copies of the Exp41 topology and memory state.
design.falsification_criterion: The longitudinal distinction fails if during_bfs and post_bfs do not diverge in propagation capacity during training, or if the operational capacity difference vanishes at washout_1. Persistence is supported only while the standardized C->D probe remains different after treatment is removed.
design.washout_interpretation: Treatment timing is removed; all branches receive the post_bfs policy. Read-only standardized propagation probes do not mutate state.

epistemic_labels.INFERRED: Any trajectory divergence follows from the declared processing-dependent update rules; the no-learning control tests whether those rules create the persistence.
epistemic_labels.OBSERVED: The exact deterministic trajectories and readouts generated by this synthetic harness.
epistemic_labels.PROPOSED: Experience consolidation, association strengthening, decay, and the washout schedule are model rules, not Raven/MNEME behavior.
epistemic_labels.UNKNOWN: Whether comparable longitudinal effects occur in Raven, MNEME, or deployed agents.

limits: Deterministic hand-built graph and update rules; no stochasticity, agent decisions, persistent external memory engine, Raven runtime, or MNEME integration. The numerical persistence is a property of this declared model until tested elsewhere.

no_learning_negative_control.purpose: Check whether a persistent state/association difference appears without the declared experience updates.
